events.category: Site-responsive durational organ work / experimental composition
events.factual_description: The Metropolitan Museum of Art presents Jonny Greenwood: 112 Years of Reverb on Saturday, February 27, 2027 from 12:00 PM to 8:00 PM in Gallery 371, Arms and Armor. The Met describes it as Greenwood's meditative eight-hour work performed on the museum's Appleton organ and lists tickets starting at $65. Faber Music identifies the work as X Years of Reverb, gives its duration as 480 minutes and genre as organ, and independently lists the February 27 Met realization with James McVinnie and Eliza McCarthy. Faber records the work's first performance on May 18, 2024 at Octagon Chapel in Norwich and documents other site-numbered realizations, so this Met performance is not described here as the world premiere.

en.why_it_matters: This is not Radiohead repertory moved into a museum. Greenwood's eight-hour organ piece is built around the idea that a room stores musical memory, and at The Met that premise lands on the Appleton organ inside Arms and Armor. The duration matters as much as the instrument: it turns listening into a slow occupation of the gallery, with McVinnie and McCarthy realizing a work whose identity changes with the age and history of the place that receives it.
en.trip_verdict: From the DMV, this is one New York date I would build a day around rather than squeeze between other plans. The noon-to-eight format is the commitment: arrive ready to give the Met the day and treat anything else in the city as secondary.
en.listen_before: There is no verified recording of this Met realization; approach X Years of Reverb as a durational work rather than using a Radiohead record as a promised set-list proxy.

es.why_it_matters: Esto no es repertorio de Radiohead trasladado a un museo. La pieza de órgano de ocho horas de Greenwood parte de la idea de que una sala guarda memoria sonora, y en el Met esa idea cae sobre el órgano Appleton dentro de Arms and Armor. La duración importa tanto como el instrumento: convierte la escucha en una ocupación lenta de la galería, con McVinnie y McCarthy realizando una obra cuya identidad cambia con la edad y la historia del lugar que la recibe.
es.trip_verdict: Desde el DMV, ésta sí es una fecha de Nueva York alrededor de la cual construiría el día, no algo que intentaría meter entre otros planes. El formato de mediodía a ocho de la noche es el compromiso: llegaría dispuesto a darle el día al Met y dejaría cualquier otra cosa en la ciudad en segundo plano.
es.listen_before: No hay una grabación verificada de esta realización en el Met; entraría a X Years of Reverb como obra de duración extendida y no usaría un disco de Radiohead como promesa de repertorio.
